scope: Synthetic generalized-Maxwell (Prony, 1-8 branches) strain-controlled uniaxial-stress material-point driver. Not calibrated, not compared with experiments, no plasticity/damage/structural integration.

syntheticParameters.note: Synthetic fixture extending the 2026-10-23 reference design values; not a measured material.

protocol: E11 ramp 0->0.03 in 1 s, hold 2 s, unload to 0 in 1 s, hold 2 s, reload to 0.03 in 1 s; 20 steps per segment; lateral S22=S33=0
verification: one-branch driver equals existing finite-visco-reference step-by-step (S11, sigma11, dissipation; S22=S33~0)
equal-tau two branches equal one summed branch
energy balance per step and cumulative; dissipation nondecreasing
glassy (dt/tau=5e-6) and fully relaxed (200 tau) limits match independent closed-form uniaxial oracle
faster loading raises peak P11; error decreases under step refinement 8/16/32 vs 256

refusals: calibrated/synthetic flags, extra fields, 0 or 9 branches, sum mu_k > mu_inf, K/mu out of range, tau 0, stretch > 1.05, >4096 steps, zero duration, non-integer steps, empty segments; input unchanged
unverified: no experimental data: no calibration, no comparison with measured load/hold/unload curves
stretch envelope stays 0.95-1.05; no strong-ellipticity argument for wider range
within-step lateral path is linear-E approximation; only refinement convergence shown
full CI not run in this session
remainingParentAcceptance: Experimental calibration, finite plasticity/viscoplasticity, damage, structural path (reactions, Cauchy, deformed area), dumbbell necking and mesh regularization, RESULTCURVE1 history integration.
